outputs.explanation: Body weight, LW/BW, and FW/BW are shown as scatter plots with mean ± SD, and individual mouse data points (dots/squares) are clearly overlaid for each group.
Gross anatomical photographs, not a quantitative plot.
Representative micrographs (H&E and Oil Red O staining), not a quantitative plot.
Dot blot and methylene blue staining images, not a quantitative plot.
Bar chart of 5mC/Methylene Blue ratio shows mean ± SD bars with individual data points overlaid for each animal (n=5 per group).
The western blot images are not quantitative plots, but the bottom bar chart quantifying TET1/TET2/TET3 over GAPDH shows mean ± SEM bars with individual data points overlaid for each sample.
